correctness.rationale: The six allocations reduce to three complementary pair partitions. With continuous data, level \(1/3\) rejection is equivalent to the original labels forming the two smallest or two largest pooled values. Standardized Gaussian pair contrasts reduce the event to an isotropic three-dimensional cone; the trihedral solid-angle formula gives the displayed closed form. Strict concavity of \(x\mapsto\operatorname{arsinh}(\sqrt{x})\) yields the unique minimum at equal variances and the endpoint limit \(1/2\).
